label: Camp Lejeune contaminated water
authority: Honoring America's Veterans and Caring for Camp Lejeune Families Act of 2012; Camp Lejeune Justice Act of 2022

locations: Marine Corps Air Station New River

presumptiveConditions: Aplastic anemia and other myelodysplastic syndromes
notes: At least 30 cumulative days of service at Camp Lejeune between August 1953 and December 1987 presumes exposure to contaminated water for the listed conditions. A presumptive condition usually does not need a paid nexus letter.
